exclusionApplication: PROPOSAL ONLY. Root may edit only STM-scoped .gitignore or use explicit allowlisted paths; do not alter root TEST_DAC8562 ignore behavior. If output/validation is ignored, exact selected evidence must be explicit -f additions or relocated to a deliberate publication snapshot by root. Never force-add entire output.

largeFileDecision.recommendation: Current84.38MB native file can be intentionally included in regular Git with a warning; use the compressed self-contained20.6MB epro2 as reproducible recovery authority. If long-term native DB history grows, explicitly choose LFS or snapshot-only export workflow before crossing100MiB. Do not silently introduce quota/billing or migrate other project history.

secretAndNoiseReview.filenameScan: No candidate secret/key/env/credential filenames found outside ignored tools/tmp; cache .pyc files found and should be excluded.
secretAndNoiseReview.configAndScriptsPatternScan: No secret-pattern matches; paths/UUIDs in config/easyeda-project.json are machine/project guards, not credentials.
secretAndNoiseReview.broaderTextPatternScan: No matches for private-key headers or recognizable GitHub/OpenAI/Slack/AWS token patterns in nonignored readable STM text; excluded binary project/archive/PDF/STEP/image files were not content-scanned.
secretAndNoiseReview.thirdPartyDatasheets: Do not publish downloaded TI PDFs under old candidate output by default; preserve links and derived library evidence instead.
secretAndNoiseReview.nestedAccidentalOutput: STM32H747 board/output/validation/tmp-placed-schema.json is nested under the STM scope again; exclude it, do not delete it in this publication step.
secretAndNoiseReview.localConfigPortability: Current config/easyeda-project.json includes absolute path and live window/project IDs. Document rebind-on-clone or publish a portable example after root review; do not change live safety guards during PCB work.

recommendedRootSequence: Finish the authorized PCB edit, save/reopen/validate and export a uniquely named18Oct WIP epro2; do not label unfinished PCB fabrication-ready.
Update README/status to exact current DRC and incomplete functionality, and select current plus needed recovery checkpoints explicitly.
Apply only STM-scoped ignore improvements or use the concrete allowlist. Exclude runtime/tmp/cache/autobackup/historical output. Preserve all on disk.
Record SHA256/size for final native project and epro2 snapshot; verify no WAL/SHM/lock artifacts and checkpoint opens independently.
Stage explicit STM32H747 paths only; inspect git diff --cached --name-only and require every path begins STM32H747 board/ and none begins TEST_DAC8562/. Do not use git add . or git add -A.
Inspect staged diff and large blobs; then commit/push according to user authorization. Root must verify remote state immediately before push; this report only knows cached origin/main.
After push, verify published commit/remote hash and leave the pre-existing TEST_DAC8562 tracked modification untouched.
policySummary: GitHub warns for files above50MiB and blocks regular-Git files above100MiB. Push payload limit is2GB. Raw workspace3.5GB is not the compressed push size, but blanket publication is unnecessarily large and noisy.
